title: Geopolitical Risks End AI-Fueled Rally Across Global Stock Markets
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Global markets weakened as renewed U.S.-Iran tensions, volatile oil prices and concerns over inflation pressured stocks and pushed investors toward safe-haven assets.

title: Asian Stocks Rise While U.S. Futures Slip Amid Progress in U.S.-Iran Talks
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Asian Markets Mixed as U.S.-Iran Peace Hopes Push Oil Lower.webp
excerpt: Asian markets delivered mixed performances and oil prices declined as investors reacted to progress in U.S.-Iran negotiations, while U.S. futures moved lower ahead of key economic data.

title: Nvidia Reports Record $81.6 Billion Quarter as AI Boom Accelerates
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $81.6 billion as booming global demand for AI infrastructure and Blackwell AI chips continued driving explosive growth.

title: Allbirds Rebrands as Smartbird, Abandons Footwear to Focus on AI Infrastructure
author: Markets Desk
excerpt: Former footwear company Allbirds has officially rebranded as Smartbird, appointed a new AI-focused CEO and completed its transition into an artificial intelligence infrastructure business.

title: Oil Prices Rise as United States-Iran Talks Keep Markets on Edge
author: Maria Sanchez
excerpt: Oil prices climbed as investors monitored fragile U.S.-Iran negotiations and uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, while global stock markets continued rallying.

title: Global Stocks Rise as Iran-Israel Tensions Ease and Chipmakers Lead Rally
author: Jessica Wu
excerpt: Global stock markets moved higher as concerns over a wider Iran-Israel conflict eased. Semiconductor and technology stocks led gains, while investors shifted focus back to earnings, AI growth and economic data.

title: SpaceX IPO Expands to $85.7 Billion After Underwriters Exercise Greenshoe Option
author: Alex Thorne
excerpt: SpaceX’s record-breaking IPO grew to $85.7 billion after underwriters exercised the greenshoe option, highlighting extraordinary investor demand for Elon Musk’s aerospace company.

title: Nikkei 225 Surges to Historic Peak on Artificial Intelligence Optimism
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Japan’s stock market reached a new all-time high as investors poured money into AI-related technology, semiconductor and industrial manufacturing companies.
